page.layout: One column of running text, left of centre; no notes in the left margin. Running head at top, page number at top right. Right margin holds only a dark handwritten mark, not printed text. Gathering signature at foot centre-left.

main_text.p: ciuntur, Testamento exhe-res filius, interpretis esse con-stat, & quidem imperiti. interpretatio enim militis haec fuit: Te-stamētum patris nullius momenti est, quippe in quo ego filius sum praeteritus. D. Immo valet. Q. An valeat? R. Quia praeteritus non dicitur is, quem pater exheredem esse voluit, te vero exheredatum voluisse constat ex eo, quia cū superius testamentum in quo exheredem te fecerat iminutauit, nullam tui in posterio-re mentionem interposuit. F. At tamen exheredem menominatim [?] etiam in posteriore fieri oportuit. Praeteritus e-nim
main_text.head: Note

page.notes: No marginal printed notes. The dark mark in the right margin beside the lines is handwriting or show-through and is not transcribed. "menominatim" is uncertain: the line break gives "meno / minatim" with no hyphen, and the first word is doubtful. "iminutauit" is also doubtful, as the line break falls inside the word. The last line "nim" completes "e-nim" and sits beside the signature "n 2". The <head> "Note" above is not printed on the page and should be removed; it is shown here only as a placeholder error. The rest of the running text is copied as printed.
